verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring scrape jobs is a fair axis for a crawling library or server, but the evidence pack never documents a built-in scheduler or cron-style job timing. The nearest items do not qualify: one-off crawl calls, retries, checkpoint resume and a Dockerized FastAPI server are different features, and community mentions of bridging to n8n are a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times
